description: This file defines a utility enum 'CameraCapturePipelineSupport' with static methods for preparing and managing camera sessions, including photo and movie capture, error handling, and session warm-up procedures in an iOS app using AVFoundation.

methods.name: preparePhotoSession
methods.description: Prepares an AVCaptureSession for taking photos, selecting camera device, and configuring photo output.

methods.name: prepareMovieSession
methods.description: Prepares an AVCaptureSession for recording movies, including optional audio and duration settings.

methods.name: prepareWarmMovieSession
methods.description: Prepares and warms up a movie capture session asynchronously.

methods.name: withWarmMovieSession
methods.description: Executes an operation with a warmed-up movie session, ensuring proper start and stop of session.

methods.name: mapMovieSetupError
methods.description: Maps camera session configuration errors to specific error types.

methods.name: makePhotoSettings
methods.description: Creates AVCapturePhotoSettings with JPEG format if available.

methods.name: capturePhotoData
methods.description: Captures photo data asynchronously using a delegate.

methods.name: warmUpCaptureSession
methods.description: Adds a delay to reduce initial blank frames after starting the capture session.

methods.name: positionLabel
methods.description: Returns a string label for camera device position.
